[[Guardsman Gahrik]] guards the bridge leading into [[Beknur Harbor]].

==Locations==
*[[Istan]]
**{{NPC location|Cliffs of Dohjok}} (right outside Beknur Harbor)

==Dialogue==
;Default; Non-Nightfall characters or after completing the [[Jokanur Diggings]] mission:
:''"Welcome to the [[Issnur Isles]]. If you're looking for more adventure, you've come to the right place. While Beknur Harbor behind me is safe enough, the solders beyond the village could use a good deal of taming."''

;Before completing the Jokanur Diggings mission:
:''"Ahai! I heard all about your role in saving [[Chahbek Village]]. You live up to the reputation of the [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]]! Behind me lies Beknur Harbor, home of the farmers and fishers of the solders. We have this place under control, so you'll have to go find another village to save. Besides, [[Kormir]] needs heroes like <character name> in the thick of the action. Not running around the countryside."''
